semiconductor_relevance: High — Guanli Technology specializes in semiconductor-specific equipment and services, making it a relevant player in the semiconductor industry.
summary: Guanli Technology provides comprehensive equipment integration and technical services across the semiconductor, new energy, display panel, and high-end packaging sectors. The company is dedicated to delivering high-purity chemical and polishing slurry supply systems, as well as advanced wet process equipment, ensuring precision and performance that meet international standards.
